artworks.title: Pelias Recognizes Jason (fresco, MANN inv. 111436)
artworks.description: Pompeian fresco from the House of Jason (IX.5.18), now MANN inv. 111436: King Pelias halts on a temple stair as he sees the one-sandaled youth — the omen that the man who will take his throne has arrived. The usurper of Iolcus is caught at the instant the Argo's voyage is born.

artworks.title: Jason Bringing Pelias the Golden Fleece (Louvre K 127)
artworks.description: Apulian red-figure calyx krater in the Louvre (K 127): Jason presents the Golden Fleece to Pelias while a winged Nike moves to crown the hero. South Italian vase painting stages the Iolcan king's impossible errand fulfilled — the prize Pelias thought would kill his nephew returned to his court.

artworks.title: The Murder of Pelias by His Daughters
artworks.description: Academic canvas of Medea's trick: Pelias' daughters, convinced they will rejuvenate their father, cut him down in the cauldron. Moreau de Tours freezes the Iolcan king's end — the revenge Jason's Colchian wife visits on the uncle who stole the throne.

artworks.title: The Sacrifice of King Pelias
artworks.description: Carracci's drawing for the Jason cycle stages Pelias at the sacrificial altar — the king whose death at his daughters' hands closes the Iolcan half of the Argonaut saga. Preparatory work linked to the Palazzo Fava frescoes in Bologna.

artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Pelias
artworks.description: Agostino Carracci's print of Pelias' sacrificial death — the same Medea-engineered murder that empties the throne of Iolcus. Bolognese reception keeps the usurper's end beside Jason's fleece as the moral hinge of the saga.

films.title: Jason and the Argonauts
films.description: Harryhausen's Pelias is the usurper who sends Jason for the fleece — the uncle whose throne-theft starts the Argo's voyage.

films.title: Medea
films.description: Pasolini keeps Pelias in the Iolcan frame: the king Jason must reclaim, before Corinth and Medea's later revenge take the film.

films.title: Jason and the Argonauts
films.description: Dennis Hopper's Pelias opens the Hallmark miniseries by murdering Aeson — the usurper whose fleece errand and knife end bookend Jason's quest.

popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Apollonius opens the fleece quest on Pelias' fear of the one-sandaled man — the Iolcan usurper whose errand sends Jason to Colchis.
